people.name: Bar-jesus
people.line: A Jewish sorcerer who opposed Paul and Barnabas.

people.name: Paphos
people.line: A city on the island of Cyprus

translations.web: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar Jesus,
translations.bsb: They traveled through the whole island as far as Paphos, where they found a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet named Bar-Jesus,
translations.kjv: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Barjesus:
